config.carriers: a45_duration_levers.parts_of(record_path(seed, wall)), every seed and wall, FieldBuilder main entry

chains.shape: nonnegative column-stochastic, two to five random destinations per node and a cycle x -> x+1; one reroute in five moves the whole of the source's outflow

channels.new_route_weight: mean of the source's route weights

config.closing: a set whose only way out is one route of k; that route turned back into the set; both ways: the outside's route in turned back as well

criteria.detail: 200 chains of 5 to 60 nodes, one in five rerouted whole, largest node gap 8.7e-16 (tolerance 1e-09); on the reducible two-node chain, where node 1 is transient and the first-passage form has no value, the step gives (0.6667, 0.3333), gap 5.6e-16, denominator 1.5000
criteria.name: B136-1  the exact finite step: pi' = pi + (v'pi)/(1 - v'Zu) Zu against the re-solved stationary vector
B136-2  the first-passage form on irreducible chains: (Z(e_j - r))_i = pi_i (m(r->i) - m(j->i)), passage times solved on their own

criteria.detail: 90 graphs of 8 to 32 nodes, largest gap 7.7e-14 relative to the largest passage time (tolerance 1e-09)
criteria.name: B136-3  the reversible limit: on B103's weighted graphs, commute time is vol times B103's resistance, Tetali's form holds, and the rerouting's direction is written in resistances

criteria.detail: 30 gated chains, largest relative spread 6.1e-11 (bound 1e-09); 30 with a back door, least spread 5.8e-01 (must exceed 1e-06)
criteria.name: B136-4  behind a gate every node moves by the gate's relative amount, and a back door breaks it

criteria.detail: determinant ratio on 200 chains, largest gap 2.4e-15; 40 closing reroutes, least |denominator| 1.96e-01, largest share left outside 2.3e-15; removed both ways, largest least singular value 1.4e-16
criteria.name: B136-5  the denominator is the determinant ratio; one column changed never makes it vanish, a rerouting that closes a set sends the whole split into it, and a change on both sides is singular

criteria.detail: 1020 channels (750 added, 270 cut) on 15 carriers: change against u v' 2.8e-17; 46 change nothing (34 added, 12 cut, v zero on 46); on the other 974 the second singular value over the first is 1.0e-15 (bound 1e-12); exact step against the re-solve 1.3e-14 (tolerance 1e-09); first order against A45's derivative 1.7e-18
criteria.name: B136-6  on A45's map one route added or cut changes the block by one outer product u v', v the source's row of the wage-and-bill step: rank one, or nothing when a factor is zero; the exact step matches the rebuilt map, and its first order is A45's derivative

criteria.detail: 15 rows (3 variants, 5 seeds); upward out-degree 4: 150 terms, rank 47 to 49; f2i 10: 20 terms, rank 20; f2i 60: 20 terms, rank 20 (singular values above 1e-12 counted); factors against the change 4.2e-17; class shares against A45's recorded exact column, largest gap 4.9e-11 (tolerance 1e-09, the record carries ten places)
criteria.name: B136-7  A45's exact column for its three edge-lever variants, rebuilt as a Woodbury step from one outer-product term per source whose routes the lever changes; the change's rank is at most the number of terms

criteria.detail: 1020 channel rows over 18 (source, destination, kind) cells on 15 carriers, all finite; reversibility read on 15 carriers, the block's own stationary vector solved to 9.3e-16
criteria.name: B136-8  channel readings printed on every carrier: class shares moved, the denominator, the source's own relative move, the destination's move, and how far the carrier's holdings block is from reversible, under the whole map's stationary vector and under its own

reducible_example.action: a quarter of node 0's outflow to node 1
reducible_example.chain: B = [[1, 1/2], [0, 1/2]], columns are where a unit goes
reducible_example.passage_0_to_1: infinite: the passage system is 0 * m = 1
